title: Subdivision tree removal letter from Arborist Committee
summary: A homeowner testified to the Arborist Committee against a subdivision board's plan to remove trees, and members noted the committee has no regulatory power. A letter to the subdivision's board was set for the August agenda, and the chair asked to learn of the subdivision board's next meeting.

timeline.text: The chair asked to be told of the subdivision board's next meeting so a committee member can attend.
A letter to the subdivision's board will go on the August agenda for the committee to approve.
A homeowner testified against a subdivision board's plan to remove trees.
